plan: docs/STAGE_PLAN.md (X3, R2 approved 30df3b9; code R1 310f7d0 -> R2 dee252b; v3 = X3-Q2fix after the smoke preflight OOM; v4 = X3-HS pack-native GFS history after the smoke Q4 binding failure); decisions docs/review/DECISIONS.md stage X3
history_rule: X3-HS: every window's GFS history comes from the preparation of its own frozen pack (K/P and HoT train/validation: A3 hourly grid = development preparation; HoT test packs: sealed-prep point cache via run_x2.hot_test_history); bound to x50 channel 20 for every window and hour before use in q1, q2 and q4; the A3 grid may differ from a native source only (a) where A3 is NaN, the native value finite and the hour a development-boundary hour (outside_development), or (b) where A3 is finite, the native value NaN and the hour's available cycle predates the native source's first day (sealed cache start edge, HS0); values never differ

q1.group_key: (farm, issue_time); exactly one issue group per predict call; members' history ends at the issue hour
q1.selection: per farm, lowest V1 MAE of the median; ties -> shorter context, then single
q1.descriptive_note: X3-HS A3 recheck: 24 h single on every context (168 h single is a candidate); never a Q1 candidate; reported in results.json a3_recheck
q1.q4_masked: also 512 h single on the validation context with upstream channels NaN on flagged hours (Q4 C_zs input); never a Q1 candidate

q2.budget: fixed uniform random subset of 20000 fit-segment windows per farm (seed 2024, without replacement); NOT the full fit segment
q2.mode_rule: first mode passing the preflight on every farm, frozen before any formal fine-tune
q2.training_mode: single-series windows with the farm's Q1-selected context length; not a fine-tune of a group-mode winner
q2.selection: V1 median MAE by custom callback (not eval_loss)
q2.batch_note: batch_size counts target+covariate rows; 2.3.2 adds whole windows until >= 256 rows: 18 windows (270 rows) per optimizer step, drawn with replacement
q2.microbatch_rule: X3-Q2fix (smoke OOM at 1024 h under gpu_fraction 0.7): [rows per microbatch, gradient accumulation]; every pair keeps 18 windows per optimizer step; preflight order full x plan, then lora x plan; first passing on every farm; lora requires peft importable (never the SDK's silent fallback)

q4.target_window_rule: target windows: every input hour >= D-k months and every label time < D (actual times)
q4.features: run_x3.PHYS_NAMES, 111 columns incl. gfs_hist_0..23 (raw m/s, NaN = missing, bound to x50 channel 20)
q4.evaluation: target V1 (right after D_T); primary pair C_zs vs L_1X; L_k and k=3 descriptive
